applicability.rationale: A rewrite is costly and the actual bottleneck has not been established.

requestedIntervention.rationale: The rewrite was proposed to reduce request latency.

desiredOutcomes.statement: The service meets its p95 latency objective under the representative workload without unacceptable operational cost.
successMeasures: p95 request latency at the declared load
CPU and memory remain inside the resource envelope

currentBaseline.description: The current parser is assumed to be the bottleneck, but no profile isolates parsing from storage and downstream calls.
noChangeConsequences: Latency remains above target if the parser is in fact causal

causalHypothesis.statement: Parser CPU and allocation behavior materially cause the latency miss, and a Rust implementation can reduce that cost without shifting the bottleneck.
causalHypothesis.mechanism: Lower parse CPU, allocation, and copying reduce end-to-end service time.
assumptions: Parsing is a material fraction of the critical path
falsifiers: Profiling shows storage or network dominates
A targeted optimization meets the objective without a rewrite

constraints.statement: Existing accepted inputs and diagnostics must remain compatible.

alternatives.intervention: Profile the critical path and optimize the current implementation

counterfactual.question: If the parser were rewritten in Rust exactly as requested, when would the latency problem remain?
failureConditions: Parsing is not the dominant critical-path cost
Integration or serialization overhead offsets parser gains
counterfactual.conclusion: The intervention cannot be selected responsibly until a bounded profile and prototype discriminate among the alternatives.

successEvidence.measure: Share of critical-path latency attributable to parsing
successEvidence.thresholdOrSignal: Enough attributable cost exists for the proposed improvement to close the SLO gap

risk.rationale: The rewrite is expensive and interface-sensitive while the causal premise is weak.

disposition.selectedDirection: Do not commit to the rewrite yet.
disposition.rationale: A profile and bounded prototype have higher information value than choosing an implementation language now.
investigationPlan: Prototype the smallest parser hot path only if profiling supports the hypothesis

blockers: Complete the investigation before selecting a production direction
